text:
Maya: quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Prefetch Optimization initiative this week. customer asks landed + security constraints. can we map deps and launch gates?
Arun: high level: runtime needs KV-cache changes, infra needs extra reserved GPUs for dedicated pilot, security needs dataflow sign-off. timeline depends on KV work estimate.
Priya: KV-cache change is small functional-wise but impacts memory layout. estimate 2w dev + 1w integration. risk: cache invalidation edgecases.
Leo: infra can reserve a 4-GPU pool for a 2-week pilot if we get heads-up by Mon. need perf profile (p95, throughput) and an ingress estimate.
Hana: security: must validate no PII lands in cache. require a gating checklist: (1) schema-level redaction, (2) KMS-backed encryption for KV at rest, (3) audit logging. ETA for review: 5 business days after PR.
Zoe: product ops: suggested launch criteria from PM — acceptance tests pass, p95 < 120ms on pilot traffic, & <10% token cost increase vs baseline. can those be realistic?
Arun: p95 <120ms is tight for long context but doable if runtime enables prefix caching and priority batching. cost target depends on batch sizes; will simulate.
Priya: agree. I'll prototype quantized kernel path and prefix cache. If we hit perf regressions, fallback to smaller model variant via routing policy.
Maya: good — can we capture fallback model name? also need rollback plan and canary %s.
Priya: fallback model: rwi/llama-13b-quant8 (compat tests green).
Sam: SRE: runbook items — trigger when errors >1% or p50 degrades >30% for 5m. also health-checks for KV throughput.
Leo: infra note — HSM/KMS integration may add latency. Hana, can we do a review for acceptable added crypto latency?
Hana: yes, we'll run a perf baseline. if KMS adds >15ms median, we want a configurable path to disable at-rest encryption for private pilot (enterprise only) while keeping audit hooks.
Zoe: rollout plan proposal: Phase A internal canary (10% traffic, 48h), Phase B pilot customers (50% of their traffic, 72h), Phase C full. feature-flag gating each phase.
Maya: perfect. devs provide canary config and a short checklist for signoff. can someone draft the checklist?
Arun: I'll sketch a minimal checklist: 1) unit + integration tests, 2) perf bench results (p50/p95), 3) KV correctness tests, 4) security signoff, 5) infra capacity confirmed, 6) rollback button and runbook.
Priya: adding: 7) model-fallback test that routes to fallback within 30s of failure.
Hana: add: 8) KMS proof + audit logs available in console.
Maya: sweet. can we get a schedule? if KV dev starts Tue, integration the following week, security review completes by end of next week, then internal canary target is 2 weeks out.
Leo: confirm infra reservation window for that 2-week slot. will follow up with exact instance IDs.
Sam: I'll prep the runbook and simulated chaos test (kill worker, cold-cache warmup) for canary start. ETA 4 business days.
Zoe: I'll coordinate with the customer success owner for pilot invites and acceptance criteria.
Arun: quick config snippet for the feature flag we'll use: 
```json
{
  "feature": "adaptive-prefetch-2",
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "fallback": "rwi/llama-13b-quant8",
  "slo_p95_ms": 120
}
```
Maya: thanks. action items: Arun -> checklist & tests, Priya -> KV prototype + fallback test, Leo -> reserve infra, Hana -> start KMS review, Sam -> runbook + chaos, Zoe -> pilot invites. update here EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
